title: Facebook Posts to PDF
description: Scrape Facebook posts, capture screenshots, and merge them into one PDF.

facebookProfileUrl.title: Facebook Profile URL
facebookProfileUrl.description: The Facebook profile URL whose posts you want to capture.

resultsLimit.title: Maximum Posts
resultsLimit.description: Maximum number of Facebook posts to retrieve.

onlyPostsNewerThan.title: Only Posts Newer Than
onlyPostsNewerThan.description: Only retrieve posts newer than this date. Use YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-01-01.

viewportWidth.title: Screenshot Width
viewportWidth.description: Width of the browser viewport used to capture each Facebook post, in pixels.

viewportHeight.title: Screenshot Height
viewportHeight.description: Height of the browser viewport used to capture each Facebook post, in pixels.

maxImageHeight.title: Maximum Image Height
maxImageHeight.description: Maximum screenshot height in pixels before cropping. Set to 0 to disable cropping.

pageSize.title: PDF Page Size
pageSize.description: Page size used for the final PDF document.
